ideas.idea: Add absolute canonical URLs on each page (Absolute canonical rule: 0 of 2 routes)
ideas.why: No canonical exists anywhere in the code, and adding one per route is a concrete, repo-specific fix.

ideas.idea: List actual routes as text on the guides page, ideally each with its own page and address
ideas.why: guides.vue promises graded routes but lists none, so adding real content and URLs gives readers and crawlers something to index and quote.

ideas.idea: Add more descriptive text on the home page about who the site is for and what it covers
ideas.why: index.vue has only an h1 and a button, so a short description helps people and machines understand the site.

ideas.idea: Set a site URL in nuxt.config (e.g. via a Nuxt site module) to generate correct absolute canonicals and sitemap URLs
ideas.why: The config has no site URL, and sitemap.xml uses a placeholder domain, so this supports absolute URLs.

ideas.idea: Make sure the placeholder domain trailhead.example in sitemap.xml is the real origin and matches canonicals and the Sitemap line
ideas.why: sitemap.xml really uses https://trailhead.example/, and the origin must be consistent across canonicals, the sitemap and robots.txt.

ideas.idea: Use the Nitro middleware noindex caveat: on a static host the header may not run, so check with a live scan
ideas.why: It is a check of the deployment outside the code, and the noindex removal already covers the actual fix.
